texts.en: The last of the [GetPreFTLLower] [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been abducted into slavery from the surface of [From.From.GetName], their homeworld. A few scattered survivors might still be roaming the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness, but not enough to maintain any kind of civilization.
